strings.en: Garden Races is a 3D-printable ecosystem for building a customizable all-wheel-drive RC truck and off-road track. Optimized for compact home 3D printers, it requires minimal supports for rapid assembly. The design seamlessly integrates with standard CyberBrick electronics and controllers, making the build process incredibly accessible. Drivers can fully personalize their racing experience using interchangeable wheels, bumpers, body styles, and modular track obstacles like bridges and ramps.

strings.en: CyberBrick Mk20 & 1A4 brings one of the smallest German weapon carrier to life in a highly detailed 1/16 scale RC build. The compact hull, functional tracks, working lights, and articulated main gun give it the right mix between scale-model realism and hands-on movement. Two distinct variants show its early life form the 1980’s to its recent combat readiness in the 2000’s. Its small footprint and big character make it a fascinating build for young and old with enough mechanical detail to make the build as rewarding as possible.
